questions.q: Explain how poverty can reduce the productive potential of an economy.

ideas.label: Poverty leads to poorer health or education
So productivity is lower, or fewer people can work

questions.model: Poverty leads to poorer health and education, which reduces human capital. Workers are less productive, so the productive potential of the economy is lower.
questions.why: Poverty today is less human capital tomorrow.

tests.answer: Poverty leads to poor education, so workers have lower productivity.
